summative_rubric.title: G2 Tap to Pay — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against F1.1.

rows.expectation_text: identify different ways of representing the same amount of money up to Canadian 200¢ using various combinations of coins, and up to $200 using various combinations of $1 and $2 coins and $5, $10, $20, $50, and $100 bills

levels.descriptor: Cannot make a combo. Wrong totals.
Independently finds 3 combos for amounts up to $200.
Finds fewest pieces and explains equivalence.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 = grade-level.

summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 4 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Money Master certificates.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.
